steps.en: Install MAX into a pixi (or uv) project
steps.zh: 在 pixi（或 uv）项目里装上 MAX

steps.en: Start an endpoint on a model from the library
steps.zh: 对库里的模型启动一个服务端点

steps.en: Downloads, compiles the model once into fused kernels for your GPU, starts the server
steps.zh: 下载模型，一次性编译成适配你 GPU 的融合 kernel，再起服务

steps.en: Point any OpenAI client at the endpoint
steps.zh: 把任意 OpenAI 客户端指向这个端点

steps.en: Serves chat completions from the compiled graph on NVIDIA, AMD, or CPU
steps.zh: 用编译好的图在 NVIDIA、AMD 或 CPU 上响应补全请求

value.en: One engine serves open models across NVIDIA and AMD behind a drop-in OpenAI endpoint — no per-vendor stack, no CUDA C++ for the hot path
value.zh: 一套引擎在 NVIDIA 与 AMD 上服务开源模型，兼容 OpenAI，热路径不写 CUDA C++

sources: max.modular.com/get-started (retrieved 2026-09-28): pixi add max-all; max serve --model google/gemma-4-31B-it; OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:8000/v1", api_key="EMPTY"); 'download the model, compile it, and start the server'; NVIDIA/AMD/CPU support
